alignment.time_origin: First ego timeline_ns; host receive clock.
alignment.ego_mapping: Nearest actual timeline_ns source frame, resampled on host time at 30 Hz; repeated frames are not interpolated.
alignment.uncertainty_kind: Approximate visual review tolerance, not a physical/statistical synchronization bound.

events.event: Right turn from parked cars into driveway; checked host6,8,10.
Left turn at yellow store entrance wall; checked host216,218,220.

opennwm.proposal_family: Historical planner: constant XY delta for 4 steps and terminal yaw adjustment.
opennwm.final_action: Elite mean of raw Gaussian parameters; final stochastic rollout is rerun from this action.
opennwm.historical_yaw_refit_correction: Refit raw terminal_yaw/pi instead of converted radians; prevents repeated pi multiplication.
opennwm.trajectory_integration: SE(2) integration of current-body model actions; historical unrotated cumsum metrics also exported separately.
opennwm.metric_definition: ATE: translation RMSE over 4 future positions. RPE: adjacent-position displacement RMSE over 3 pairs, identity pose orientations, no alignment or scale correction.
opennwm.context: Four recorded past frames; autoregressive latent feedback within each 1-second window.
opennwm.reference: Go2 sport local odometry (meters/radians), not independent motion-capture ground truth.
opennwm.scope: Offline image-goal planning; recorded context resets every 1 seconds; no robot execution.
opennwm.note: New held-out recording. Practical CEM budget explicitly differs from archived Table 2; same ATE/RPE metric definitions.
